title: Fenestra Specification Schema
description: JSON Schema for validating Fenestra Description documents

sdks.description: SDK ecosystem definitions indexed by SDK identifier

extensionPoints.description: Where UI can be injected in the host platform

declarativeSchemas.description: JSON-based UI schema definitions (e.g., Slack Block Kit, Adaptive Cards)

title.description: Human-readable title for the Fenestra Description

summary.description: A short summary of the platform's UI capabilities

version.description: Version of this Fenestra Description document

appMarketplace.description: URL to the platform's app marketplace

installCommand.description: Full install command for quick setup

cdn.description: CDN URL for script tag loading

cdnRequired.description: Whether SDK must be loaded from CDN

extensionTypeConfig.description: Configuration specific to the extension type. Schema varies based on extensionType value.

templateInvocation.description: Agent can invoke pre-defined UI templates

actionChaining.description: Agent can chain multiple UI interactions

name.description: Protocol name (e.g., mcp, openai-functions, anthropic-tools, langchain-tools, custom)

templateDiscovery.description: Agent can query available UI templates

available.description: Available context types (e.g., conversationHistory, userIdentity, currentDocument)

methods.description: Available invocation methods (e.g., templates, customIframe, deepLinks)

chainingSupported.description: Whether chaining multiple interactions is supported

supported.description: Supported event types (e.g., formSubmitted, actionClicked, uiDismissed, errorOccurred)

canPerformActions.description: Agent can perform actions (not just show UI)
